integrity: Exact all-parameter identity follows from finite cosine series and sign segmentation; asymptotic error from derivative-jump Fourier expansion. Finite checks are not universal proof.
scientific_limitations: Fixed-m O_m(N^{-3}) remainder; only consecutive spectrum and ℓ1/ℓ∞ endpoints; generic Bernoulli jump-correction is prior art.
title: Exact endpoint norms and residue law for consecutive cyclic Fourier projections
